name: Lightning Arrow Deadeye
summary: League-start bow build. One skill in the body armour, a physical bow with attack speed, and gem levels carry the damage: nothing here needs a unique, so the same gear works on day one of a solo league. It is the second build the pipeline proves, and the first that is not a minion one.
